# Rendering Strategy and Optimization


## Overview
Rendering Strategy and Optimization is a family of techniques that accelerate volume rendering by optimizing the efficiency of [ray-grid traversal](#17-ray-grid-traversal.md) and determining optimal data structures for a given scene. It addresses the computational bottleneck of evaluating every voxel or primitive along a ray, which is often redundant due to empty space or coarse sampling. Unlike sibling methods that define specific traversal algorithms (e.g., DDA, Octree), this family focuses on *how* to execute traversal more efficiently (via hardware awareness or algorithmic shortcuts) and *what* resolution to use (via cost models) to minimize total rendering time.

## Shared principles
All methods in this family build on [Ray-grid traversal](17-ray-grid-traversal.md), which advances analytically from one cell boundary to the next. The core mechanism determines the next cell by comparing distances to upcoming boundaries on the x, y, and z axes, selecting the minimum distance to advance. [Optimization and cost models](#15795-optimization-and-cost-models.md) do not alter this fundamental geometric logic but instead optimize the *cost* of executing it or the *parameters* (like grid resolution) under which it runs.

## Subtopics

### [Coherent and Connectivity Traversal](14777-coherent-and-connectivity-traversal.md)
This family accelerates ray-grid traversal by exploiting spatial coherence among [ray bundles](#2179-ray-bundle.md) or by enforcing strict topological connectivity rules to resolve boundary ambiguities. Unlike standard cell-by-cell methods like [Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) Traversal](3061-digital-differential-analyzer-dda-traversal.md) which process rays individually and may suffer from divergence or diagonal jumps, this family processes rays as coherent frustums or resolves tie-breaking conditions explicitly. It solves the problem of packet divergence in coherent ray tracing and normal inaccuracies in [uniform grid traversal](#9652-uniform-grid-traversal.md).

### [Rendering Order and Strategy](14814-rendering-order-and-strategy.md)
[Rendering Order and Strategy](#14814-rendering-order-and-strategy.md) defines the sequence in which volumetric cells are processed during ray-grid traversal to ensure correct optical [compositing](#2436-compositing.md) (typically front-to-back) and efficient occlusion culling. It solves the problem of determining which cells contribute to the final pixel color and in what order, distinguishing itself from sibling methods by decoupling the geometric traversal logic (handled by the parent [Ray-grid traversal](17-ray-grid-traversal.md)) from the semantic processing order required for correct [alpha blending](#5750-alpha-blending.md) or visibility determination.

### [Optimization and Cost Models](15795-optimization-and-cost-models.md)
This family encompasses techniques that accelerate volume rendering by optimizing the efficiency of ray-grid traversal and determining optimal data structures for a given scene.
